date_seo_1.name: {name}
date_seo_1.text: *In front of the fountain, Seoyeon is standing there. She got here first.*

date_seo_compliment_choice.name: {name}
choices: You went all out today, huh.

date_seo_pretty_high.name: {name}
date_seo_pretty_high.text: *Seoyeon pauses for a moment. -- Then she smiles. Not with her lips, but with her eyes.*

date_seo_pretty_high_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_2.text: *She turns her gaze away, tucking a strand of hair behind her ear.* ...Let's get some fresh air.

date_seo_pretty_high_4.name: {name}
date_seo_pretty_high_4.text: *She said 'Don't get the wrong idea,' but her hand, pushing back her hair, is unnecessarily busy.*

date_seo_pretty_low.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_low.text: ...Where'd that come from. Warn me before you say things like that.

date_seo_bright.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_bright.text: Of course. I put in a little effort today.

date_seo_walk.name: {name}
date_seo_walk.text: *We walk through the park. We toss bread to the ducks.*

date_seo_duck.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck.text: They're simple, these guys. Bread, they follow. No bread, they don't.

date_seo_duck_2.name: {name}
date_seo_duck_2.text: People aren't that different, are they?

date_seo_duck_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_duck_3.text: People sometimes don't come, even when you give them bread.

date_seo_duck_4.name: {name}
date_seo_duck_4.text: *It sounds offhand -- but Seoyeon's own experience bleeds through it.*

date_seo_flower_2.name: {name}
date_seo_flower_2.text: *Seoyeon pushes the flower shop door. A bell chimes.*

date_seo_succulent_2.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_2.text: This one's easy. Survives even if you forget to water it.

date_seo_succulent_3.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_succulent_3.text: If you can keep it alive. — If not, I'm taking it back.

date_seo_end.name: {name}
date_seo_end.text: *What Seoyeon handed me. — My hands tremble as I take it.*

date_yuna_1.name: {name}
date_yuna_1.text: *In front of the cafe. Yuna is leaning against the wall. A black dress and a small crossbody bag.*

date_yuna_compliment_choice.name: {name}
choices: First time I'm seeing you out of uniform.

date_yuna_pretty_high.name: {name}
date_yuna_pretty_high.text: *Yuna pauses for a moment. She lowers her head slightly.*

date_yuna_pretty_high_5.name: {name}
date_yuna_pretty_high_5.text: *Again? -- Yuna is asking for a once more.*

date_yuna_pretty_low.name: Yuna
date_yuna_pretty_low.text: ...No one's ever said that to me before.

date_yuna_bookstore.name: {name}
date_yuna_bookstore.text: *We head to a bookstore. Yuna walks slowly between the shelves.*

date_yuna_bookstore_3.name: Yuna
date_yuna_bookstore_3.text: ...Good. So I get to be the one who showed you first.

date_yuna_earphone.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone.text: *Yuna hands me one of her earbuds.*

date_yuna_earphone_3.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_3.text: *The distance between us is the length of the earphone cord. Thirty centimeters. — Any closer and we touch, any farther and it falls out.*

date_yuna_oldbook.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook.text: *We pass a secondhand bookshop. Yuna stops walking.*

date_yuna_oldbook_2.name: Yuna
date_yuna_oldbook_2.text: I read this a year ago. Back then, the ending felt sad.

date_yuna_end.name: {name}
date_yuna_end.text: *Yuna looks at me as she says it. -- In her eyes, because of you is written plainly.*

date_dain_1.name: {name}
date_dain_1.text: *In front of the gym. Dain comes running over. Cap and sportswear.*

date_dain_2.name: Dain
date_dain_2.text: You made it!! Cutting it close, weren't you?!

date_dain_3.name: {name}
date_dain_3.text: I got here ten minutes early.

date_dain_4.name: Dain
date_dain_4.text: I was here twenty minutes ago!!

date_dain_compliment_choice.name: {name}
choices: That cap looks good on you.

date_dain_pretty_high.name: {name}
date_dain_pretty_high.text: *Dain freezes. Her eyes go wide. -- Then she pulls her cap down over her face.*

date_dain_pretty_high_2.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_high_2.text: WHAT — you can't just SAY stuff like that!!

date_dain_pretty_high_4.name: {name}
date_dain_pretty_high_4.text: *She said 'if you say things like that,' but her voice was trembling.*

date_dain_pretty_low.name: Dain
date_dain_pretty_low.text: WHAT — !! ...Haha, thanks, but stop, it's embarrassing.

date_dain_bright.name: Dain
date_dain_bright.text: OBVIOUSLY!! I'm in peak form today!!

date_dain_arcade.name: {name}
date_dain_arcade.text: *We stand in front of a rhythm game machine. The screen flickers.*

date_dain_arcade_2.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_2.text: Okay, bet time!! Loser buys drinks!!

date_dain_rhythm.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm.text: *Pointing at the screen* This score — it's the second highest ever!!

date_dain_rhythm_3.name: Dain
date_dain_rhythm_3.text: LOL OBVIOUSLY!! This one doesn't need knees!!

date_dain_knee.name: {name}
date_dain_knee.text: *Doesn't need knees. -- She said it lightly, but there's weight behind it.*

date_dain_knee_2.name: {name}
date_dain_knee_2.text: *We stepped out of the arcade onto the street.*

pre_confess_minsu.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu.text: yo you on your date right? one thing

pre_confess_minsu_2.name: Minsu
pre_confess_minsu_2.text: do it right this time. don't run

pre_confess_callback.name: {name}
pre_confess_callback.text: *The phone in my pocket feels heavy. No notifications. — Like that first day, when I saw a name flash on the screen and shoved it back in. I can't run like that again. Not this time.*

date_seo_end_b.name: {name}
date_seo_end_b.text: *We left the park and walked down the street.*

date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_pretty_high_3_b.text: *Tucking her hair back* ...Don't get the wrong idea.

date_seo_flower_b.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_flower_b.text: *Stopping in her tracks* ...Want to go in?

date_yuna_earphone_2_b.name: {name}
date_yuna_earphone_2_b.text: *A quiet piano piece flows in. The noise of the bookstore fades away.*

date_yuna_oldbook_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_oldbook_c.text: *She pulls out an old book. Flipping through the pages.*

date_dain_shop_3_b.name: Dain
date_dain_shop_3_b.text: *From under her cap* ...Say that one more time and I'll seriously hit you.

date_dain_arcade_3_c.name: Dain
date_dain_arcade_3_c.text: *Squealing* Full combo!! Did you see that?!

date_seo_end_d.name: Seoyeon
date_seo_end_d.text: It was nice. — Just know that.

date_yuna_end_b.name: Yuna
date_yuna_end_b.text: *Just before parting, she hands over a note. Without a word.*

date_yuna_end_c.name: {name}
date_yuna_end_c.text: *'I had a lot of sentences today. Only in front of you.' — Yuna's handwriting is trembling.*

date_dain_end_c.name: Dain
date_dain_end_c.text: Today was really fun. ...Without the exclamation mark.
